title: Affine pushforward base change map is invertible
statement: For an affine morphism f and a quasi-coherent module F, the canonical module base change map in any cartesian square is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the affine-open local isomorphism criterion after proving bijectivity on every affine open section.
